convert_swin2sr_checkpoint: convert a Swin2SR checkpoint from the original repository to a PyTorch model and save it locally
convert_state_dict: convert a Swin2SR state dict from the original repository format to HuggingFace Transformers format
rename_key: rename a Swin2SR checkpoint key from the original repository naming to HuggingFace Transformers naming
get_config: get a Swin2SRConfig from a checkpoint URL by detecting the model variant
summarize_convert_swin2sr_checkpoint: summarize the convert_swin2sr_checkpoint function that downloads, converts, and verifies a Swin2SR checkpoint
